head: ^rite-cadence: git could not run: .*$
why: With no git on PATH both exit 1 and print 'rite-cadence: git could not run: ' and a reason; the reason is the runtime's own text (Python's OSError, '[Errno 2] No such file or directory: git'; the CLI's 'git was not found on PATH', since it looks git up before spawning). The prefix and the exit code are still compared.
